description: Role update: name validation, built-in role protection and capability set changes.

cases.inputs: id: that role; Name: "Thư ký chính"; Description: "Phụ trách biên bản".
cases.log: Audit row RoleUpdated (details { before, after }); log "Role {RoleId} updated by {ActorId}."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Custom role "Thư ký phó" held by 3 accounts.
cases.return: RoleResult Success (MSG22) with the new name and description and userCount 3; capabilities and sessions are untouched.

cases.inputs: id: <random Guid with no role>; valid request.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.

cases.inputs: id: that role; Name: "Quản trị cấp cao".
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Built-in role "Quản trị viên".
cases.return: RoleResult Failure(BuiltInRole) (MSG24); the role is unchanged.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Built-in role and a blank name submitted.
cases.return: RoleResult Failure(BuiltInRole) (MSG24): the built-in check comes before field validation.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Custom role exists.
cases.return: RoleResult InvalidInformation (MSG20) with errors[name] = "Tên vai trò không được để trống.".

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Custom role exists.
cases.return: RoleResult InvalidInformation (MSG20) with errors[name] = "Tên vai trò không được vượt quá 64 ký tự.".

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Custom role exists.
Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Custom role exists.
cases.return: RoleResult InvalidInformation (MSG20) with errors[description] = "Mô tả không được vượt quá 256 ký tự.".

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Custom role "Thư ký phó" with description "Hỗ trợ".
cases.return: RoleResult Success (MSG22) with the current data; nothing is written and no audit row is added.

cases.inputs: Name: "THƯ KÝ PHÓ" (only the letter case changes).
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Custom role "Thư ký phó".
cases.return: RoleResult Success (MSG22): re-casing the role's own name is a change, not a duplicate.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Custom role "Thư ký phó" with description "Hỗ trợ".
cases.return: RoleResult Success (MSG22); the description is cleared to null and the change is audited.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Another role "Thành viên" exists.
cases.return: RoleResult Failure(DuplicateName) (MSG21); the role keeps its name.

cases.log: Log "Role update rejected: name already taken (unique index)."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The name is free when checked, but a concurrent request takes it before the save.

cases.log: Log "Role update rejected: the role no longer exists."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The role is deleted by another administrator between reading and saving.
cases.return: RoleResult Failure(NotFound) (HTTP 404): the save matches no row; the client refreshes its list.

cases.log: Error log "Role update failed to save."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The database refuses the save (connection lost or timeout).
cases.return: RoleResult Failure(SaveFailed) (MSG27); the role keeps its previous data.

precondition: Roles seeded, one built-in and one custom.
